title: Four years ago, NASA punched an asteroid. Europe's Hera probe arrives this month to inspect the wreckage
caption:
NASA’s DART mission successfully nudged an asteroid, but the story is far from over. This month, the ESA’s Hera probe arrives at the crash site to investigate the aftermath of our first planetary defense test.
